geometry_method.negative_control: A province mismatch or top-share below 95% aborts reproduction; a translated synthetic polygon must produce IoU below 0.5.
geometry_method.operation: Intersection share of each pinned ADM2 source polygon against all pinned ADM1 source province polygons; select greatest share.
geometry_method.positive_control: Each of 226 source districts has its issue-declared province as the unique top intersection at >=95% area; identical polygons produce area shares and IoU of 1.0.
